name.en: OECD Ministerial Council Meeting 2027 (chaired by Czechia)
name.zh: 2027 年 OECD 部長理事會（捷克擔任主席）

title.en: Ministers discuss getting industrial policy right
title.zh: 部長會議聚焦「做對產業政策」

summary.en: The June 2026 Ministerial Council Meeting, chaired by Finland, focused on industrial policies that keep markets open.
summary.zh: 2026年6月由芬蘭主持的部長理事會，主題是如何在維持市場開放下推動產業政策。

question.en: When should governments subsidize industries like chips or batteries, and when does it hurt trade?
question.zh: 政府何時該補貼晶片、電池等產業？何時反而傷害貿易？

title.zh: 能源衝擊推升通膨預測

summary.en: The OECD forecast 2.9% world growth for 2026 and raised its inflation forecasts because of the Middle East conflict and energy prices.
summary.zh: OECD預測2026年全球成長2.9%，並因中東衝突與能源價格上調通膨預測。

question.en: How does an oil price shock affect inflation and interest rates in Taiwan?
question.zh: 油價衝擊如何影響台灣的通膨與利率？

title.en: Czechia to chair the 2027 ministerial meeting
title.zh: 捷克將主持2027年部長理事會

summary.en: The OECD Council chose Czechia to chair its 2027 Ministerial Council Meeting, the first time the country takes this role.
summary.zh: OECD理事會指定捷克主持2027年部長理事會，這是捷克首次擔任此角色。

question.en: What can smaller member countries gain from chairing an international meeting?
question.zh: 較小的成員國主持國際會議能得到什麼好處？

text.en: OEEC founded to manage Marshall Plan aid
text.zh: 歐洲經濟合作組織成立，管理馬歇爾計畫援助

text.en: OEEC becomes the OECD with US and Canada
text.zh: OEEC改組為OECD，美國與加拿大加入
日本加入，成為首個亞洲成員

text.en: Global minimum tax deal agreed (Pillar Two)
text.zh: 達成全球最低稅負協議（支柱二）

text.en: Pillar Two 'side-by-side' package agreed with the US
text.zh: 與美國達成支柱二「並行」方案
